notes.title: Announcing Tropical Daze!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33642319/4cb004caa9f983f2295bf0f0230670103f87bc3c.png[/img]

The much anticipated sequel to Snow Daze is now in production! Join Jason as he schemes to add even more girls to his harem. His aunt and three lovely cousins run a tropical resort far away from his home. Pack your bags and bring your brainwashing device - it's time for a vacation!  Tropical Daze is entering early production.

Stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: Hello everyone! It’s finally time!!
notes.notes:
It’s still amazing this is actually happening! Even after being approved on Steam, we held some doubts on whether on not this could work. But now we are gladly willing to ride out this new frontier and see what it has in store.

A big thanks to our publisher Critical Bliss for support and helping us make this possible! They have their own debut project that they set aside for a moment to help us with this, and we are thankful for it. Please keep an eye on their page as well for a updates. 

We hope you enjoy Snow Daze and have a good time helping Jason snuggle up with his step-family through the blizzard.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33642319/8ea181e14879851392a34fcd00d6995decb67c42.png[/img]
